Only `live` is ever emitted. `pending` is a candidate list: it is NEVER read by checkout, schema, feed or pages (a test fails the build if it leaks). To launch a country now: add its code to `liveWave` (one-line data change; its row stays in `pending`, shipping + delivery estimate + faster option come from its `route` in `deliveryRoutes`). Legacy manual way: fill printSite, shippingRate, handlingDays, transitDays from IngramSpark's ship-to data (pmpublish 2026-11-09, /home/deploy/aeo-state/fhb-ingram-shipto-20261108.json), set status live, and move the row from `pending` to `live`. Rates are fixed per order (Stripe shipping rates cannot vary by item count). shippingRate.value is a decimal string in `currency`.

model._readme: PER-BOOK COST MODEL (Kevin 2026-11-24 'This needs to get fixed NOW! Our site is saying ships to 223 countries but then is it charging $50 a book to do so?'). marginGuard.modelledLandedUsd prices a book WITHOUT its own measured landed_cost_usd.<cost_key> from its OWN specs: print = fixed + per-page by print site x binding x interior (Ingram calculator, economy, qty 1, fitted to the cent on pmpublish smp-books-landed-20261113 + smp-store-costs-20261115) x printSafety (FC/RIAB pb read 11-23/24 ~6-7% above the 11-13 fit) + site handling, converted at fx; shipping = the grid country's MEASURED cheapest-tracked shipping as a function of the book's estimated weight (pages/2 x trim area x gsm + 2 x trim area x cover), interpolated between measured knots (upper envelope; Bible rows anchor the heavy end where measured; beyond the last knot +heavySlope USD/kg). A country outside the grid takes the MAX over its zone's grid countries (the rule ZONE_MAX Bible rows already use). The result never exceeds the country's Bible cost for the same binding. Fitted + calibrated by projects/store-intl-cost-model/fit_model.py (noah, 2026-11-24); proof scripts/book-cost-model.test.mjs.

deliveryRoutes._readme: Delivery model per route. A pending row names its route. handlingDays = Ingram dispatch in business days (measured: economy 5 paperback / 10 hardcover, rush 1 / 2). transitDays = carrier transit in business days, an ESTIMATE from conservative published carrier ranges (Ingram's calculator shows dispatch only; transit is UNMEASURED). fast = the optional buyer-paid 'Expedited delivery' option: extra_usd is OUR extra cost per copy = (rush print - economy print) + (fastest reasonable tracked duty-paid method - the free method), USD at the fx above, rounded UP to the cent. Its price is computed in src/lib/shipCountries.ts (fastPriceCents) as extra x 1.10 plus the Stripe fee on it, rounded up to a .99 price point, and scales with copies. fast=null means the option is NOT offered. Where no sane faster tracked duty-paid method exists the option is rush PRINT only (same label 'Expedited delivery', the name stays short, extra = rush print delta, transit unchanged). Full table + sources: /home/deploy/aeo-state/fhb-intl-decisions-2kd-20261108.json.

forwarder._readme: FORWARDER ROUTE (Kevin 2026-11-25, pmshipping brief jobs/pmshipping-ukraine-np-route-20261125.md; kevin-decisions 2026-11-24 'Let's find a way to ship to Ukraine if the buyer is willing to pay and we make an average profit.' + 2026-11-25 'do these: - The three Ukraine-route decisions'). Ingram cannot ship to Ukraine (rate table no_method). SHIP-TO COUNTRY RULE for EVERY physical product (scope 'all'; Kevin 2026-11-26 L3025 'this is not to be a product provision but a country provision for all products. ONLY Ukhraine checkout forms should show this credit'; 'bibles' = FHB Bible SKUs only), whoever the buyer is: the buyer registers free at npshopping.com and gets a Nova Poshta US address (East Hanover NJ, NP account code as address line 2); Ingram LS US ships Standard Ground there; Nova Poshta forwards to the buyer's branch and the buyer pays NP's fee at pickup. We give a $30.00 credit per ORDER (Stripe amount_off coupon `coupon`, named `credit_name`) and NO first-order 15%. landed_usd per Bible SKU = MEASURED (Ingram print unit + Standard Ground to NJ 9.69, LP set 11.79) x (1 + NJ sales tax 0.06625), pmshipping from Ingram order pages 2026-11-25 (= `ingram_with_tax` in `source`). marginGuard nets each Bible copy as list - Stripe 4.4%+0.30 on list - landed - the whole credit (the CSV's method, conservative for multi-copy orders) and REFUSES a SKU below floor_usd (never a handling fee here). A book absent from landed_usd is MODELLED (US print model + ship_usd) x (1 + tax) and keeps the books' handling fee, sized on its net AFTER the credit. The credit text reaches a page only from the server (storeEngine.shipToCredit), never a static page. The shipper desk parks every UA order NEED_NP_ADDRESS until the buyer's NP US address arrives.
